quests.title: Down in the Dumps

dialogue.t: ...I detect an energy reaction in the vicinity...
Um... W—Where are we??? {NICKNAME}, are you alright?
Paimon can't believe that scary giant bird attacked us just like that, with zero warning! Do you think that scary giant thing is that "Zhara" Nastya was talking about...?
So Nastya lied to us!? Aw, come on! Paimon was really looking forward to this!

dialogue.sit: Maybe Nastya didn't lie to us...

dialogue.t: Oh! Wait, wait... Are you saying Zhara's only like this to us? Then maybe it's because... y'know... we don't have branches sticking out of our heads like Nastya?
But to that monster whose sole objective is to preserve the status quo here, our approaching is a form of danger.
Huh? But why, though...? We're only here to get Goggles' body part back, that's all...
Oh! Oh! Paimon gets it now! It's all because of Goggles' power! That's what's making this town feel so warm and weird!
Yes, that is correct.
That half-man, half-bird creature named Zhara... and the way the local residents have transformed in both body and mind... All of these feel extremely familiar to me.
I can remember now... one of the four who created my body back then at some secret location... He was a leading figure of Snezhnaya's now-vanished school of bio-alchemy...
...Koshchei the Deathless.
All these we are seeing are very much aligned with his approach to "life."
Hmm... So the thing we're looking for is with this Koshchei person?
Sheesh... This town feels even weirder now...
So anyway... first we take Nastya home, then we look for Koshchei or whatever his name is, right?
That's... gonna keep us busy for a while.

dialogue.sit: We should find a way to get back to the ground first.

dialogue.t: Yeah, there's no way we'll find anything just hanging around here... Come on! Let's get out of this dump, fast!
Then we'll ask Nastya when we find her!
Insert the three keys

...Must undergo three rounds of authentication... Obtain the <color=#00E1FFFF>Red, White, and Blue Keys</color> and place them at three different locations... Insert them into the slots to activate the gate...

Hmm, this is written in such a complicated way... Looks like there's a name written on the cover of this tattered little book... "Doctor Moreau"? Uh, so these are the notes written by that kind doctor?
Whatever. So all we have to do is go to these three spots and find the <color=#00E1FFFF>red, white, and blue keys</color>...
...Then we insert them into the three places, and... and we should be able to get out, right?
Ding ding ding! Paimon's got the blue key!

dialogue.sit: We're counting on you here, Paimon!

dialogue.t: But how did the people who built this even get around here? Did they have wings too or something???

quests.description: You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible…
